spans.s:
हिडिम्ब हिडिम्ब, अस्, m. a gigantic Rāk-
ṣasa slain by Bhīma; (आ), f. Hiḍimba's sister (who
changed herself into a beautiful woman and married
Bhīma; he had a son by her named Ghaṭotkaca);
the wife of Hanumat.
—हिडिम्ब-जित्, त्, m. ‘con-
queror of Hiḍimba,’ Bhīma.
—हिडिम्ब-निसूदन,
अस्, or हिडिम्ब-भिद्, त्, m. ‘destroyer of Hiḍimba,’
Bhīma.
—हिडिम्ब-वध or -बध, अस्, m. ‘the
killing of Hiḍimba,’ an episode of the Mahā-bhārata
(Ādi-parvan, section 152 — 156, verse 5927).
—हि-
डिम्बा-पति, इस्, m. ‘husband of Hiḍimbā,’ epi-
thet of Bhīma; of Hanumat.
—हिडिम्बा-रमण,
अस्, m. epithet of Bhīma; of Hanumat.
